parole.significato: maar (broad, low-relief volcanic crater caused by a phreatomagmatic eruption)
parole.testo: Attested since at least the 16th century, from an underlying Middle High German *mar(e). Adopted into scientific parlance during the 19th century from Central Franconian dialects of the Eifel region, home to many maars, which often include the word in their names.
